# glad

`include/glad/gl.h` is a header-only OpenGL 3.3 loader generated by [glad 2](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad)
(it is the loader that ships with GLFW 3.4 in `deps/glad/gl.h`).

- Code generated by glad is public domain / CC0 (see the glad project).
- It is derived from the Khronos OpenGL API registry (Apache License 2.0).
- The embedded `khrplatform.h` section carries the Khronos MIT-style license reproduced inside the header.
